description: Put a name and a source on a mod. Looks up metadata across platforms (Nexus, mod.io) in one normalized shape: id, name, author, version, downloads, endorsements, pageUrl, and a permissions block that always carries attribution. Use it to enrich a crashlog suspect or a load-order entry — "who made this", "look up this mod", "what version is X". Thunderstore support is planned.

gameId.description: Platform-specific game identifier. For Nexus: the domain name (e.g. 'skyrimspecialedition'). For mod.io: the numeric game id as a string. Use modio_list_games / nexus_list_games to discover these.

modId.description: Platform-specific mod ID. Nexus IDs are numeric (from the URL); mod.io IDs are numeric too. Required for direct lookup.

modName.description: Mod name for fuzzy lookup (mod.io only — Nexus has no public search endpoint). Pass with gameId.

platform.description: Which platform to query. Default 'any' — tries Nexus first when a numeric modId + gameId are given, then mod.io. Use explicit platform to skip the cascade.

name: mw_query_mod_metadata
